note: The person's verbs that pick what a call does when the model wrote it otherwise (SaidVerbs). Each entry is compared as folded words (lower case, no accents, single spaces: SaidFolders.Spoken). append: a file.write without append over a file of theirs that is there goes as an append when the turn says one of these and none of keepWhole. overwrite: a file.edit of a file of theirs that is there goes as the file.write of its newText over all of it, under the file's hash (the person's yes first), and a file.write without hash nor append over such a file goes under its hash, when the turn says one of these (not «reemplaza X por Y», an edit). operators: a calculator.expression.evaluate of a bare number they said goes as that operator and the number when the turn says words of exactly one of them. copy: a call of an operation that takes copy, without copy, goes with copy when the turn says one of these and none of move. negations and clauseBreaks (encargo 61b): the person's words are cut into clauses at , ; : . ? ! and at a clauseBreak, and a name after a negation in its clause is not asked for (answer_check's «no / nunca / sin»), as the Calculator named in «no uses la calculadora».
